method: Actual inferInterests/inferExcludedInterests and planRoute calls on independently frozen source and real saved OSM POI+walking graph; fixed 2026-10-20T12:00+05:00. No model or network. Legacy has no includeMode, unsupported or control-conflict fields, so its effective union behavior is any and absence of required disclosures is recorded.
limits: 30 selected adversarial cases, not a representative population sample.
Canonical gallery→art mapping is reported only for semantic comparison; raw legacy outputs retained.
A missing all-category stop is not automatically a planner defect; feasibility and truthful partial/empty disclosure must be evaluated separately.
trace.ms contains observed non-deterministic local elapsed times.
